about: A pushed commit's Release-note trailer cannot be rewritten, because main is never force pushed. Where one was wrong, the note that replaces it is written here, by the commit's full hash, and scripts/release-notes.py reads it in the trailer's place. Each says why.

f1d775ea501a92b9f98c0335192b0da02aca6f02.why: Entry 266's README commit said the application did not change, but it also changed one word in the volunteer pack, which ships; nightly 120 refused it.

notes.note: The printed volunteer pack's ruler check now spells center the American way, as the rest of GroupLab does. (Entry 266)

9a41376b9ca332cf62d723afe27071067158f41a.why: Entries 279 and 280's licence note named Apple's testing service by its product name, which the note check reads as a name only this repository knows; nightly 123 refused it.

notes.note: Fudd buster mode, Unholy's idea, shows with your own shots why a few shots mislead: the tightest and widest three-shot groups among them, what averaging small groups would have said, and the zero chased five shots at a time. (Entry 279, 3)
On the phone, a target GroupLab did not print can now be marked by hand: set a known length and the aim point, then add each hole under a crosshair that stays in the middle. (Entry 279, 2)

The status bar now says when the target was saved and where, with Show in folder, and it saves by itself once you change or accept it; Settings can switch to a Save button instead. (Entries 279 and 281)
A tap on a number now switches that number alone, and GroupLab remembers the unit for that figure; the others follow Settings as before. (Entry 280, 1)
GroupLab's license now allows it to be distributed through Apple's App Store and its test service, as work on an iPhone and iPad version begins. (Entry 279, 1)

02fb365c31dbfb93f6e70c09b00fab424385da30.why: Nightly 130 refused the note: the checker reads the name of Apple's test service as a code name (as it did for nightly 123).

notes.note: GroupLab for iPhone and iPad keeps the image analysis it needs when the application is linked, ahead of the first test build for Apple devices. (Entry 290)

notes.note: Printing straight to the Phomemo M834 from Android now prints the whole page: GroupLab keeps the connection open until the printer says it has finished, instead of stopping after a few millimeters. (Entry 381)

4893d78216f5eb1d998879fbd27ab5ccfc773d80.why: Entry 400's commit promised a third sooner; the same day its codes read at once were taken back after the Mobile suite hung on macOS, leaving about a tenth.

notes.note: On the phone, a photographed GroupLab target's result comes up about a tenth sooner after the picture is taken, measured by running the phone's own reading on a computer. (Entry 400)
